Based on the retrieved excerpts, here are the ISO 45001 clauses that require you to capture the new fall-protection rule and verify compliance:

## Capturing the New Rule

**Clause 6.1.3** — Requires you to:
- Determine and access up-to-date legal requirements applicable to your hazards and OH&S risks
- Work out how they apply to your operations
- Account for them when building and running your system
- Retain documented information on these requirements

This clause obligates you to identify the new January-effective fall-protection rules, assess how they apply to your residential construction work, and document this information.

## Verifying You're Meeting It

**Clause 9.1.2** — Specifically mandates a compliance evaluation process:
- Establish a process to evaluate compliance with legal requirements
- Determine frequency and methods of evaluation
- Evaluate actual compliance
- Maintain knowledge of your compliance status
- Retain documented information of compliance evaluation results

Additionally, **Clause 9.1.1** supports this by requiring you to monitor and measure "progress on legal and other compliance" as part of your broader monitoring and measurement activities, with results retained as documented information.

## Summary Table

| Activity | Primary Clause |
|----------|---------------|
| Identify and capture new legal requirement | **6.1.3** |
| Evaluate/verify actual compliance | **9.1.2** |
| Ongoing monitoring of compliance status | **9.1.1** |

You should ensure your compliance evaluation process under 9.1.2 specifically addresses the new fall-protection rules, with evaluation timing appropriate to the January effective date.
